rule: A role is a placeholder that gets no permissions until a card is assigned. The cards assigned will define page access and read write permissions. It's that simple and there are to be zero exceptions to this rule. (Lutan, 2026-10-24)
note: Counts are lines in src/**/*.ts(x) matching `pattern`, taken from origin/main at baselineCommit. They may only go down. Read by scripts/check-hard-coded-security.mjs and, later, by the Hidden security screen. cards-grants-app was changing src/lib/permissions/cards.ts at the same time: if a count disagrees because it landed first, merge origin/main and re-baseline downward.

survivesTheTest.what: The order roles are listed on an admin screen
survivesTheTest.why: ordering only; nothing keyed by it changes what a card does or whether it shows

mechanisms.name: roles.opens_app
mechanisms.effect: denies, at the broadest scope; also gates /residents

mechanisms.name: roles.scope_clinical
mechanisms.effect: denies / silently redirects: the same card sends two roles to two different pages

mechanisms.name: roles.scope_residents / scope_contacts / scope_photos
mechanisms.where: columns on the role; src/lib/permissions/fixed-for-now.ts says Read is narrower than it looks

mechanisms.name: canUseBills
mechanisms.effect: first line denies on scopes.clinical === own_clinic; the activity checks after it are fine

mechanisms.name: page rules (route registry)
mechanisms.effect: denies: a role can hold everything a card requires and still find the page shut. Each page names one activity; the page set moves onto the card (Lutan: the cards assigned define page access)
mechanisms.note: The planner's brief counted 55; this file has 45 path entries at the baseline commit. Recorded as found.

mechanisms.name: JOBS_OF_ROLE
mechanisms.effect: GRANTS access from a role-keyed list in code with no card involved. Also mixes in tile layout: UNSEPARATED, not split here

mechanisms.name: OUTSIDE_REGISTRY
mechanisms.effect: denies for /residents, /bills, /operations, /management; /assistant and /my already follow the rule (4 of 6 do not)

mechanisms.name: CURATED_HOME
mechanisms.effect: a hand-written home screen keyed by role key decides which tiles appear: the role defines whether a card is shown, the direction Lutan ruled out

mechanisms.name: cardTile() silent drop
mechanisms.effect: re-checks the card against access the card itself applied (covered), then gives the page rules a veto (!icon || !opens); either way the tile is silently not drawn. Likely a very cheap removal; whether anything else depends on it is NOT ESTABLISHED

mechanisms.name: opensAnyIn
mechanisms.effect: not independent: any route in the section the role can open, so it inherits page-rules. Tracked, not counted as a mechanism
